title: Lift-off
caption: NASA launch-control television: the pad cameras with the count clock, then the long-range trackers
timing: soundtrack matched to the mission recordings (rms 9 ms)

title: Docking with Eagle
caption: 16-mm film through Columbia's window (shot into a mirror; flipped back): Eagle's top closes in, capture, the probe retracts
timing: capture (LVFEA 12,243.7 s; the scan jolts at 100.92 s); 12 frames/s: the probe draws the two craft together over 9 s of the film at that speed (Mission Report: 6–8 s; at 6 frames/s it would be 18 s), and magazine A's 3,386 frames last the 4 min 41 s of the journal's real-time edition

title: Eagle undocks
caption: 16-mm film from Columbia: Eagle backs away and turns so Collins can check its legs
timing: undocking (Mission Report 100:12:00; first movement in the scan at frame 1,442); 12 frames/s: magazine C's 5,612 frames last the 7 min 46 s of the journal's real-time edition

title: Landing
caption: 16-mm film out of Aldrin's window: the boulder field, West crater, the dust and the shadow at touchdown
timing: contact (contact light 102:45:39.9; Eagle's shadow fills the frame at frame 6,024.5); 6 frames/s, as the flight plan set it for the descent; the film then starts at 102:31:07, against the camera's recorded start at 102:31:04

title: One small step
caption: Live television from the camera on the equipment bay, as received at Goldstone, Honeysuckle Creek and Parkes
timing: soundtrack matched to the mission recordings (rms 45 ms)

title: Aldrin steps out
caption: Live television: Aldrin backs down the ladder, "Magnificent desolation"
timing: soundtrack matched to the mission recordings (rms 4 ms)

title: The plaque
caption: Live television: Armstrong reads the plaque on the front leg
timing: soundtrack matched to the mission recordings (rms 4 ms)

title: The flag
caption: Live television from the camera on its tripod, 18 m north-west of Eagle
timing: soundtrack matched to the mission recordings (rms 9 ms)

title: The President's call
caption: Live television: Armstrong and Aldrin by the flag take the call from the White House
timing: soundtrack matched to the mission recordings (rms 5 ms)
